name: testsandfunnels-crm
description: Root of the CRM for Node hosts (Hostinger Node.js apps, Render, Railway): `npm install` here installs the server's packages, `npm run build` builds the dashboard into backend/public, `npm start` runs it. The marketing site in website/ builds on its own.

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
